chunks: Muhammad ibn Abi Abdillah from Muawiya ibn Hakim from Ali ibn al-Hasan ibn Ribat from Muthanna from Yazeed al-Sa'igh, who said:
I heard Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) saying: 'The women do not inherit anything from the walls of the earth (foundations), but for them is the value of the bricks and the wood.'

He said, so I said to him: 'The people do not act upon this.' He said: 'When we appoint them (as rulers/judges), we will strike them with the whip. If they desist, or else we will strike against them with the sword.'

key_terms.رِبَاعِ الْأَرْضِ: Foundations/walls of the earth (structural base of a building)

ai.seo_question: What do women inherit from a house according to Imam al-Sadiq (as)?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi highlights the distinction between land (immovable) and structures (movable components) in Shia inheritance jurisprudence, where women receive the value of bricks and wood rather than the land itself. Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) emphasizes the binding nature of this ruling by noting that the governing authority enforces it through corporal punishment for initial compliance and the sword for persistent refusal, underscoring the transition from individual adherence to state-enforced legal precedent.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muawiya Bin Hukeym, form Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Rabaat, from Musny, from Yazeed Al Saig who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The women do not inherit anything from the land of the house, but for them is the value of the bricks and the wood’.

So I said, ‘The people are not taking by this’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When we<sup>asws</sup> rule them, we<sup>asws</sup> will strike them with the whip. So if they desist, or else we<sup>asws</sup> will strike against them with the sword’.
en.sarwar: 10. Muhammad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah has narrated from Mu‘awiyah ibn al-Hakim from Ali ibn al-Hassan ibn Ribat from Muthanna’ from Yazid al-Sa’igh who has narrated the following: “I once heard abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, saying, ‘Women do not inherit from the land or the house anything, however, they can have their share from the value of bricks and wood.’
He (the narrator) has said that I said to him (the Imam), ‘People do not follow it.’
He (the Imam) said, ‘When we become in authority, we will whip them, and if they will not desist we will use sword against them.’”
